verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a GPU accelerator with its supporting ROCm software stack, not a service that stores user data. User-controlled data retention and deletion policies are therefore a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships such a capability; GPU partitioning and SR-IOV are isolation features, not retention controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
